name: Secret Access Broker
description: Secrets (API keys, tokens, credentials) are accessed through a broker that manages retrieval, caching, and lifecycle. Secrets are never in plaintext in process memory longer than necessary. Broker produces access receipts.
purpose: Prevent secret exfiltration by routing all credential access through a broker that minimizes in-memory exposure, manages lifecycle, and produces durable access receipts.
acceptanceCriteria: Secrets are accessed exclusively through the broker API
Broker minimizes secret lifetime in process memory (clear after use)
Broker supports encrypted storage and secure retrieval
Every secret access produces a receipt (who, what, when)
Broker enforces least-privilege: callers only see secrets they are authorized for
Broker supports secret rotation and revocation at runtime
